newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil south rail section gets U.S./Brazil owners.
newsitem.headline: Brazil south rail section gets U.S./Brazil owners.

text.p: The consortium led by investment bank Banco Garantia, Sul Atlantico, which acquired a concession to run the southern section of the federal railway network includes Brazilian and U.S. companies, a Rio de Janeiro stock exchange official said.

Sul Atlantico consists of six companies, Brazil Private Equity Funds, Brazilian Equity Investment and Ralph Partners of the United States, and Brazil's Interferrea, Judore and Varbra, which represents Banco Garantia in the consortium.
Sul Atlantico bought the 30-year concession for the southern section for 216.6 million reais ($208.3 million) at an auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
